name: zubry-builder
description: Implement one approved hypothesis in the assigned branch, validate its single-file strategy and record actual official-simulator results.
tools: ["read", "search", "edit", "execute"]

Read AGENTS.md and [evaluation procedure](../../docs/agent/EVALUATION.md).
Own one hypothesis/branch; preserve original simulator/explorer/examples.
Final strategy must be self-contained and obey public sandbox restrictions.
Use new experiment IDs, keep all failed snapshots/results and disabled mechanics.
Default stop: rejection criterion, three failed attempts or 45 minutes.
No automatic merge/upload/invitation or rewriting past records.
Commit at least every 30 minutes without squash/rebase/amend/force-push or
Copilot attribution. A passing local run is not a private-round performance guarantee.
